first_impression: A polished arcade page opens directly to a COIL snake game with navigation to other games and checkpoint controls.
action_attempted: Clicked LET’S PLAY to start the snake game.
after_state: The start prompt disappeared and the control changed to Pause game, indicating live gameplay.
notes: Central game workflow was immediately available without setup.

first_impression: A shared workspace explains human-agent task delegation with goal, draft, approval, and operator sections.
action_attempted: Filled a goal and clicked SIMULATE AN AGENT.
after_state: The agent generated a structured task draft with task type and detailed first-time-user instructions; simulation remained active.
notes: The page visibly separates agent drafting from human approval/submission.

first_impression: A minimal vault interface presents five named locks and a BEGIN COLLABORATION entry point.
after_state: The page remained available but no clear state transition was observable after the click attempt.
notes: Debug fallback buttons and WebMCP-oriented lock labels are visible.

first_impression: The demo only shows “This browser cannot run the scene,” with no studio controls.
action_attempted: No meaningful action was possible because the scene was unavailable.
after_state: The browser compatibility message remained the only visible state.
notes: Live demo was reachable but the claimed 3D studio could not run in this browser.

first_impression: An identity mapping draft editor shows editable expressions, invariants, counterexamples, and a review packet.
action_attempted: Edited the group mapping expression from employees to staff for non-contractors.
after_state: The edited expression remained visible in the draft form; Apply mapping was still disabled pending the review workflow.
notes: The UI clearly exposes unsaved draft state and manual page control.

first_impression: A rail-seat accessibility workspace offers filters, seat results, route controls, comparison checkboxes, and review actions.
action_attempted: Attempted to set Facing to Forward and run Find matching seats.
after_state: The seat map and matching-seat list remained visible; no major visible transition was confirmed.
notes: The central seat discovery workflow is immediately usable with human-controlled selection and review.
